Strongest bet →

The wear pattern needs no participation at all, so it can't fail at low traffic. Everything else layers on top of it.
Under the seat + the rack are the two that carry actual link curation. The rack is the most Stumble-like and the most fragile when empty.

Picks: 02 fogged window + 01 under the seat, confirmed.
This round: window entry multiplied — mid-bank bays + glazed lower-wall gaps (see entry sketch). 06 now answers "isn't this just sitting?" in its footer, with a fallback if the answer doesn't hold.

Entry pattern is proximity + contextual verb — the same plumbing the carriage already uses for sit / stand / exit. No menus, no toolbar.

Window bays cost one seat per bank (top row 156 / 532 / 952 become glass slots) and glaze the two lower-wall gaps at x 262–420 / 694–840. Five bays total; dashed teal = walk-in zone.
